note: Pins are the versions this kit was last validated against. Advance only deliberately via the procedure in docs/PINS.md, and log why in PINS_LOG.md. npm versions are exact (see .npmrc) and package-lock.json is committed.

vta.featuresNote: The VTI Dockerfile default has no `tsp`, and the VTA then refuses services.tsp = true (MODE=tunnel). images:build passes this list as the FEATURES build arg for every VTA image, so one image serves all modes.

vti.why: Aligned with the VTA Farm: the VTA is the release the portal offers as image 0.65.0-fc157f76 (vta-service-v0.65.0), the VTC is the release a Farm-hosted VTC runs (vtc-service-v0.15.0). Both images are built from their own tag by `npm run images:build all`.
vti.note: The two releases come from DIFFERENT monorepo commits (fc157f76 and 93d36996), so each image is built from its own ref. The earlier single pin fff94fc6 (fc157f76 plus an examples-only commit) is retired.

cloudflared.note: Host binary on PATH (not pinned by this repo); quick tunnels only. Validated with this version in the tunnel spike.

messaging.why: MODE=tunnel (docs/MODES.md): the mediator and the VTA/VTC messaging setup were validated against this mediator tag (v0.45.0, built with tsp; the mediator lives in its own repository since 0.42, the same version the VTA 0.65.0 lockfile names). Build it with `npm run images:build mediator`.
messaging.note: Advance only deliberately via docs/PINS.md. The mediator is open-ACL in this kit by design (docs/MODES.md).

images.note: Prebuilt images published by .github/workflows/images.yml to <registry>/<image>:<short ref> (the image names and refs are the vti/messaging pins above). `digest` is the multi-arch index digest (sha256:...) that the workflow reports after a run; null means not published yet (or not recorded), and then the tag is used and `pins:check` says so. Paste the digests in, commit, and `images:pull` / `up` pull by digest. Procedure: docs/IMAGES.md.

farm.note: Dated snapshot, not a fact: the Farm updates almost daily. vta-service is an existing Farm VTA (GET /openapi.json info.version; /health has no version); vtc-service is a Farm-hosted VTC (GET /health). vtc-service is now pinned at the Farm VTC's version (0.15.0) and vtc-client sends join-requests/list and members/list 0.2. Re-run `npm run farm:probe` the day before and on the day; details in docs/FARM.md.

portal.blocker: firstperson.dev only: deploy fails after Admin DID, DID host refuses acl/grant/0.2 (unsupportedVersion); confirmed Farm-side, reproduced by hand 2026-10-29. ic3.dev creates the same image fine.
portal.preferredFarm: ic3 (https://vtafarm.ic3.dev, DID host dids.ic3.dev, agents https://vta-<name>.ic3.dev); set FARM=ic3|firstperson, default ic3; table in scripts/farm-hosts.json
portal.imageTrap: 0.56.0 (the portal's default selection at last look; not compatible with this kit)

npmNote.tsp: The TSP client (packages/tsp-client) uses @openvtc/vti-tsp-js 0.4.0, which speaks TSP 1.0, for both the end-to-end message to the VTA and the routing layer to the mediator (mediator 0.45.0 reads 1.0; the earlier mediator 0.33.1 needed a second package, vti-tsp-js 0.3.0 for Rev 3, no longer used). @openvtc/pnm-core 0.9.1 brings its own nested vti-tsp-js 0.2.0 (Rev 2), used only for its mediator login and DID resolution. Keys that start with packages/ are lockfile paths. See docs/MESSAGING.md.
